environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate tasks (0.25 vCPU, 512MB) in a private subnet (subnet-0a3f8e7c2b) within VPC vpc-04d91ae3f. The subnet route table (rtb-0f82ca1d) has NO route to a NAT gateway or internet gateway — only local VPC routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a VPC endpoint for ECR (vpce-0b4e2f). Traffic ingress is via internal NLB (network load balancer) from a separate service mesh sidecar in a different subnet. The NLB target group health check has a 5-second request timeout with deregistration on 2 consecutive failures. Fargate task has ephemeral storage only (no persistent volume). CloudWatch Container Insights enabled with anomaly detection on CPU utilization triggering task replacement at p95 > 80% sustained for 60s.

config.subnet: private subnet-0a3f8e7c2b, no NAT, no IGW route
config.load_balancer: internal NLB with 5s request timeout on target group
config.cloudwatch_anomaly_detection: CPU p95 > 80% for 60s triggers task stop/replace
config.egress: no egress path - no NAT gateway, no IGW, no VPC peering to internet-routable subnet
